card.name: "The" after prescribe with opioids
card.fires_on: The word "the" right after "prescribe" in the opioid-with-benzodiazepine warning, just before "lowest effective dosages". Weaker on "administered" in "can be administered with or without food" and on "hours" in "at least 4 hours prior".

modes.description: "the" following "prescribe" at the end of the clause about using a sedative drug together with opioids.

modes.label: Administration and spacing wording
modes.description: Weaker firing on a word in food or timing instructions, where the next word is usually "with" or "prior".
modes.example: Ezetimibe Tablets can be<< administered>> with or without food.

card.writes: It suppresses "or" words in several languages, so the next word is less likely to be "or".
card.plain: It marks a spot in the label where a fixed phrase comes next, not an "or" choice.
